Industrial Production Index: YoY: Monthl:
1. CEIC calculates Industrial Production Index Growth from monthly Industrial Production Index.
2. Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation provides Industrial Production Index with base 2022-2023=100.
3. Industrial Production Index covers Mining and Quarrying, Manufacturing, Electricity and Gas, and Water Supply, Sewerage, & Waste Management sectors.
4. Industrial Production Index Growth prior to April 2024 is calculated from from Industrial Production Index with base 2011-2012=100 and prior to April 2013 is calculated from Industrial Production Index with base 2004-2005=100 and covers Mining, Manufacturing and Electricity sectors only.
